properties.name: talentpipe.resend.api-key
properties.description: Resend API key, from {@code RESEND_API_KEY}. Deliberately has no in-repo default — when blank the application runs in console mode rather than falling back to some shared key.

properties.name: talentpipe.resend.from
properties.description: sender address, from {@code MAIL_FROM}. Resend only delivers to arbitrary recipients when this address belongs to a VERIFIED sending domain; the {@code onboarding@resend.dev} sandbox sender reaches only the Resend account owner's own inbox.

properties.name: talentpipe.security.jwt.access-token-ttl
properties.description: access token lifetime (15 minutes per architecture doc)

properties.name: talentpipe.security.jwt.refresh-token-ttl
properties.description: refresh token lifetime (7 days per architecture doc)

properties.name: talentpipe.security.jwt.secret
properties.description: HS256 signing secret sourced from the {@code JWT_SECRET} environment variable — no default on purpose, the app fails fast without it. Minimum 32 bytes (256 bits), enforced by {@link JwtTokenProvider}.
